key_findings.statement: 在6个国家中，澳大利亚（Australia）是活跃率最低的国家，活跃率为73.21%。
澳大利亚的Growth套餐活跃率最低，为57.89%，显著低于该国整体活跃率73.21%，两者差距为-15.32个百分点。
Growth套餐在澳大利亚的用户占比最高，达到33.93%，是用户规模最大的套餐，其低活跃率对整体水平影响最大。
澳大利亚各套餐活跃率差异明显，最高为87.5%（Enterprise套餐），最低为57.89%（Growth套餐），差距达29.61个百分点。
在获客渠道维度，Referral渠道活跃率最低，为60%，比澳大利亚整体活跃率73.21%低13.21个百分点。
各获客渠道的用户占比相对均衡（17.86%至23.21%），没有单一渠道主导用户规模，因此渠道因素不是低活跃率的主要驱动因素。

  SELECT o.sales_channel, o.status, o.id AS order_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
         SUM(oi.line_revenue) AS sales_amount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS refund_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
  GROUP BY o.sales_channel, o.status, o.id
),
channel_totals AS (
  SELECT sales_channel, SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales,
         SUM(refund_count) AS total_refunds, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
  FROM order_metrics
  GROUP BY sales_channel
)
SELECT om.sales_channel, om.status, om.order_count, om.sales_amount, om.refund_count, om.refund_amount,
       ROUND(CAST(om.order_count AS REAL) / ct.total_orders * 100, 2) AS status_share_pct,
       ROUND(CAST(om.refund_count AS REAL) / om.order_count * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct,
       ROUND(CAST(om.refund_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(om.sales_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS refund_value_rate_pct,
       ct.total_orders AS channel_total_orders, ct.total_sales AS channel_total_sales,
       ct.total_refunds AS channel_total_refunds, ct.total_refund_amount AS channel_total_refund_amount
FROM order_metrics AS om
JOIN channel_totals AS ct ON ct.sales_channel = om.sales_channel

key_findings.statement: 订单状态分布中，已完成订单量最高（282单），已取消订单量最低（32单），订单状态整体以完成为主，取消量相对较小。
三大销售渠道（Partner、Online等）订单量分布均衡，各渠道订单占比在32.88%至33.65%之间，但Partner渠道异常率最高（8.62%），异常订单数达15单，其中取消订单15单。
商品结构中，Accessories订单量最大（244单，占46.92%），Networking订单量最小（102单，占19.62%）；各品类退款率在12.11%至19.61%之间，整体退款率为14.23%，Networking退款率最高（19.61%）。
